name: familycfo
description: FamilyCFO — a local-first CFO for Israeli families: scrapes your banks and credit cards, then shows cash flow, budgets, forecast, net worth, insurance, pension and a stock portfolio, with an optional AI chat over your own data.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run server" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.desktop:dev: npm --prefix web run build && npm run desktop:bundle && electron .
scripts.desktop:pack: npm --prefix web run build && npm run desktop:bundle && (electron-builder --dir --publish never; s=$?; npm rebuild better-sqlite3; exit $s)
scripts.desktop:dist: npm --prefix web run build && npm run desktop:bundle && (electron-builder --publish never -c.mac.notarize=true; s=$?; npm rebuild better-sqlite3; exit $s)
